prompt: OK so we've been testing 1.0.0 on TestFlight for a week and everything looks good. I want to do a full App Store release — bump the version to 1.1.0 and release it to production. Give me the full rundown of everything I need to do.

assertions.text: Addresses the version bump from 1.0.0 to 1.1.0 (updating app.json version field)
Explains that build numbers auto-increment via EAS (appVersionSource: remote)
Includes submitting to App Store Connect
Walks through App Store Connect steps: create new version, release notes, screenshots, select build, submit for review
Mentions Apple review timeline (24-48 hours typical)
Mentions the choice between manual and automatic release after approval
